answer: A copied wallet cannot recast the same boule twice. I escrow 44.6 POA on ledge LG-4 of the south cliff garden for 49 minutes and pour a 62 mm optical crystal from 180 mL of ocean brine at 31.5 C. A 0.35 mm wire witness is fused at 14 mm depth and sawn so it cannot be reused. Peers recompute mass (71.2-73.0 g), index 1.518-1.524, and a 12-point curve at 0.8 C/min. A second LG-4 booking, or a curve within 0.12 C RMSE of another pour, slashes 66 percent and retires LG-4. If the crucible cracks before minute 18, the remainder freezes 15 hours and a new ledge is required, never the same witness.
